apps.name: Steam
apps.desc: Not available on ARM64 Linux today.
apps.note: Steam does not publish an ARM64 Linux client, so it cannot run in AURA OS. Great alternatives: the native games in this category, browser games, and cloud gaming (e.g. GeForce NOW or Xbox Cloud) in AURA Browser. For your Steam library, keep playing on the Mac side — your files stay one shared folder away.

apps.name: Ollama (CLI)
apps.note:
Ollama is not in Debian's repositories. Safe manual install:

1. Open ollama.com/download in AURA Browser.
2. Download the Linux ARM64 tarball (do not pipe scripts into sudo).
3. In Celestia Shell:
   tar -xzf ollama-linux-arm64.tar.gz -C ~/.local
   ~/.local/bin/ollama serve
4. Then:  ollama run llama3.2

Inside a VM the CPU does the work — small models (1–3B) run best, and giving the VM 6 GB RAM in UTM helps a lot. Alpaca (above) can manage Ollama for you graphically.
